title: TechTriview
description: Developed a live coding-interview platform featuring syntax-highlighted editor, collaborative whiteboard, and video/audio capabilities. Secured ₹40K seed funding from Atal Incubation Centre and successfully pitched at Aarohan Startup Summit 2025.
content:
## Overview

**TechTriview** is an advanced live coding interview platform designed for seamless scheduling, real-time collaboration, and remote technical interviews. It combines a collaborative whiteboard, syntax-highlighted code editor, and integrated video calling into a single, streamlined experience.

> 💡 *Secured ₹40K in seed funding from Atal Incubation Centre and successfully pitched at Aarohan Startup Summit 2025.*

---

## 🎬 Demo Walkthrough

<video
  src="/images/projects/techtriview/video.mp4c"
  controls
  muted
  playsinline
  class="w-full rounded-lg shadow-md my-6"
/>

---

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

| Category | Tools |
|---------|-------|
| **Framework** | Next.js 14, React 18 |
| **Language** | TypeScript |
| **Styling** | Tailwind CSS, Radix UI |
| **Real-time** | Liveblocks, Yjs |
| **Database** | Convex |
| **Authentication** | Clerk |
| **Video SDK** | Stream Video |
| **Code Editor** | Monaco Editor |

---

## 🎯 Problem & Objective

Remote technical interviews often suffer from poor collaboration, context switching, and unreliable tooling. **TechTriview** solves this by bringing scheduling, coding, whiteboarding, and video communication into a single, unified platform.

### Goals
- Conduct structured, real-time technical interviews
- Enable low-latency collaboration
- Reduce setup and coordination overhead

---

## ✨ Core Features

### 📅 Interview Scheduling
- Multi-participant interview scheduling
- Time-zone aware reminders

### 🎥 Video Conferencing
- Secure, low-latency video via Stream
- Seamless in-room integration

### 💻 Live Code Editor
- Monaco-based editor
- Real-time collaboration using Yjs + Liveblocks

### 🎨 Interactive Whiteboard
- Real-time drawing canvas
- Pencil, shapes, selection, undo/redo

### 🔐 Authentication & Roles
- Clerk-powered authentication
- Role-based access (Interviewer / Candidate)

### 🧾 Recordings & Feedback
- Automatic session recording
- Post-interview feedback and playback

---

## 🖼️ Screenshots

![Interview Room](/images/projects/techtriview/room.png)

![Live Code Editor](/images/projects/techtriview/editor.png)

![Collaborative Whiteboard](/images/projects/techtriview/whiteboard.png)

---

## 📦 Deployment

- Deployed on **Vercel** with CI/CD
- Convex deployed via `npx convex deploy`
- Environment secured via `.env.local`

---

## 📚 Learnings

- Advanced real-time collaboration using **Yjs + Liveblocks**
- Video integration with **Stream SDK**
- Managing multi-role apps with **Next.js App Router**

---

## 🔗 Links

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Preet-taparia/TechTriview)
- Live demo coming soon

title: Justify AI
description: AI-powered excuse generator using Gemini API. Built with React and AWS Lambda, hosted via AWS Amplify. Generates smart, context-aware excuses with a fully serverless architecture.
content:
**Justify AI** is a web application powered by generative AI that creates smart, context-aware **excuses**. Whether you're late for a meeting, missed a deadline, or just need a tactful way out, Justify AI helps you respond gracefully — and creatively.

---

## 🚀 Tech Stack Overview

- **Frontend**: React.js
- **Backend**: AWS Lambda (Python-based serverless function)
- **API Integration**:
  - **AI**: Gemini API (for excuse generation)
  - **Routing**: AWS API Gateway
- **Hosting & Deployment**: AWS Amplify

---

## 🧩 Architecture Overview

![Justify AI Architecture](/images/projects/JustiFI_AI/Screenshot_20250531_194844.png)

The application architecture consists of a **React frontend** hosted on **AWS Amplify**, communicating with a **Python-based AWS Lambda function** through **API Gateway**. This serverless approach ensures scalable, low-maintenance compute. Excuse generation is powered by **Gemini API**, Google's large language model.

---

## 🖼️ Application Screenshots

### 🔹 App Interface

![App Form Screenshot](/images/projects/JustiFI_AI/Screenshot_20250531_193259.png)

Users input a situation or context, and Justify AI generates a tailored excuse in real-time.

---

## 💡 Key Features

- 🧠 **Contextual Excuse Generation** – Personalized responses using Gemini API.
- 🔄 **Serverless Backend** – Scalable and cost-effective with AWS Lambda.
- ☁️ **Deployed on AWS** – Fast, reliable cloud infrastructure using Amplify.

---

## 🔧 How It Works

1. **User submits context** (e.g., “I missed class today.”)
2. **React frontend** sends the input to the backend via API Gateway.
3. **AWS Lambda function** receives the input and forwards it to **Gemini API**.
4. **Gemini API** returns a contextually appropriate excuse.
5. **Frontend displays** the generated excuse to the user.

title: Space Odyssey
description: An immersive, interactive web experience that lets users explore space through real-time data, animated storytelling, and stunning visuals using multiple public space APIs.
content:
**Space Odyssey** is an immersive, interactive web experience that allows users to explore space through real-time data, animated storytelling, and rich visuals. The project blends education with exploration using modern web technologies and public space APIs.

---

## 🌌 Features

### ✨ Animated Landing Experience
- Smooth, cinematic animations powered by **Framer Motion**
- Dark, space-themed UI for an engaging first impression

### 🪐 Explore Worlds
- 📰 **Space News** – Live articles from the Spaceflight News API
- 🖼 **Picture Paradise** – NASA APOD, Mars Rover photos, NASA Image Library
- 📚 **Space Facts** – Solar system data from Le Système Solaire API
- 👨‍🚀 **Who Is In Space?** – Live astronaut tracking via Open Notify
- 🛰 **Track the ISS** – Real-time ISS location with interactive maps

---

## 🛠 Tech Stack

| Category | Tools |
|--------|------|
| **Framework** | Next.js 13 |
| **UI** | React, Tailwind CSS |
| **Animation** | Framer Motion |
| **3D / Visuals** | Three.js, @react-three/fiber |
| **Maps** | Leaflet, React-Leaflet |
| **APIs** | NASA APIs, Spaceflight News API, Open Notify, WhereTheISS.at, Le Système Solaire API |

---

## 🖼️ Preview

![Space Odyssey Preview](/images/projects/space-odyssey/cosmic.png)

---

## 📦 Deployment

- Hosted on **Vercel**
- Environment variables managed via `.env.local`
- Optimized for performance and responsiveness

---

## 📚 Learnings

- Integrating multiple third-party APIs reliably
- Building animated storytelling experiences with **Framer Motion**
- Working with real-time spatial data and maps
- Combining 3D visuals with traditional UI

---

- [Live Demo](https://space-website-theta-azure.vercel.app/)
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Preet-taparia/Space-website)
